description: Receive over Lightning INTO this wallet via a Boltz reverse swap (NON-custodial). Returns a BOLT11 invoice for a payer to pay; once paid, the L-BTC is claimed into your wallet in the background (watched, cancelled cleanly on shutdown). An INFLOW — no guardrail. amount_sats is base units.

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

name: wallet_receive_lightning

amount_sats.description: L-BTC to be received into the wallet (base units).

invoice.description: The BOLT11 invoice for the PAYER to pay. Once paid, the L-BTC is claimed into this wallet.

lockup_address.description: The Liquid lockup address Boltz will fund.
